transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

My wife wanted me to come. She... well, she got scared. I guess I've been hearing things. Like water running inside the walls. And men whispering in there, too, even when it's just me at home. And... sometimes I see this dark, wet patch spreading on the floor in the hallway. I've touched it, and it's dry, but I still see it. So... she made the appointment.
Can you describe what you see on the hallway floor more clearly? Do you actually see something that isn't there, like water or a dark patch, or is it more like a shadow or distortion?

It's... I don't know. Like I just said, it's a dark patch. It looks wet, like it's spreading across the floor. I actually see it right there. 

But then I check it, and... it's completely dry. I guess that's what finally scared my wife so much. Watching me feel a dry floor... and listening for those men in the walls.
Do you see other things that others don't, like people, shapes, or lights, or is it mostly just the dark patch on the floor?
No... just the patch. And the water... the whispering in the walls. That's all.
Do you have any thoughts or beliefs about why the water is running or why those men are whispering, that you think might not be true?

I don't know about... what's true or not. I know how it sounds. But... I think it's the mold. And the wiring in that house. 

I'm pretty sure it's poisoned everything I own. And... I can tell the neighbors are watching. They're just waiting to see when I mess up again. That's all.
When you say the mold and wiring are poisoning everything, and that the neighbors are watching you, do you believe these things are definitely true, even though others might not agree with you?

...Yeah. I know it probably sounds far-fetched to you. But... I'm certain. 

The mold and the wiring... they really have poisoned everything I own. And... I just know the neighbors are watching. Waiting for me to mess up. I don't really care if anyone else agrees with me. I just know it.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah... I guess. Most days, I just... I wake up already feeling like I've failed. At being a husband, and... just a man. It's just this heaviness. It just sits on me until I go to bed. So... yeah.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, or found that you no longer take pleasure in them?

...Yeah. I don't really do much anymore. 

I used to be the guy who... showed up for things. Played soccer, brewed beer out in the garage... helped out at the fire department. But... I don't know. It all just feels pointless now. I can't make myself care enough to go. So I don't.
When you say you don't care enough to go to these activities anymore, is it because you no longer enjoy them, or is it more about feeling too down or unmotivated?

...I don't know. Both, I guess. 

Like I said, it just... it all feels pointless now. I don't get anything out of the brewing or the fire department anymore. There's no enjoyment. And... I just can't make myself care enough to even try.
Do you ever experience other unusual sensations, like smelling something that isn't there, feeling bugs crawling on your skin, or tasting something odd?
No. Not that I've noticed. Just... no.
Have you ever tried to question your beliefs about the mold, wiring, or neighbors watching you — like, have you thought maybe they might not be true, even for a moment?

...No. I don't question it. 

I know how it sounds. I know it sounds far-fetched. But... I'm certain. The mold, the wiring in that house... it poisoned everything I own. Everything. And the neighbors... they're just watching. Waiting to see when I mess up again. I just... I know it's true.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

...Yeah. Pretty much. 

Most days, I just... I wake up already feeling like I've failed. Failed at being a husband, at being a man. It's just this heaviness. And it just sits on me... all day, until I go to bed. So, yes.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy levels or felt unusually tired, even when you haven't been doing much?

Yeah. I guess so. 

It's just... I don't do much anymore, but I'm always tired. Just walking from the kitchen to the back room to look at the tools... it wears me out. And sitting on the couch after doesn't help. The energy doesn't come back. So, yeah. Tired.

Have you ever had thoughts or experiences where you believed something was happening that wasn't real, like seeing or hearing things that others couldn't, outside of the water sounds and dark patch you already mentioned?
...No. I don't think so. Just... just what I already told you about. Nothing else.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are being controlled by something outside of you, or that someone is putting thoughts into your mind that aren't yours?
...No. I don't... I don't feel anything like that. My thoughts are my own. They're just... mostly bad ones right now. But no one is putting them there.
Have you ever believed something that others said wasn't true, outside of what you've already mentioned about the mold, the wiring, or the neighbors watching?
No. Just... just what I said. Nothing else.
Have you ever believed something strongly that turned out to be completely untrue, something that most people wouldn't believe?
No... I don't think so. Just the things we talked about. I don't know what else to tell you.
Have you ever experienced a time when you had strange beliefs or saw or heard things that lasted for a month or more?
No... I don't think so. It's just... just the things I already told you about. I haven't noticed anything else.
Have you ever experienced any other strange sensations, beliefs, or experiences — even ones that you didn’t mention yet — that you think might be related to what’s been happening to you lately?
I don't... I really don't know why you keep asking me that. No. There's nothing else. Just what we already talked about.
Have your beliefs about the mold, the wiring, or the neighbors watching you ever changed or wavered, even slightly, since they first started?

No... they haven't. I know it probably sounds far-fetched to you, but... I'm certain. The mold and the wiring in that house... it poisoned everything I own. And I can just tell the neighbors are watching to see when I mess up again. So... no. It hasn't changed.
